integrity: The covariance is reconstructed from an explicit mixed power-sum identity obtained by independent beta-integral size-biased calculations. A standalone deterministic checker compares gamma-derivative and beta-moment routes on a parameter grid and checks the asymptotic correlation limit. Finite numerical checks are supplementary and are not used as proof for the full parameter region.
scientific_limitations: The identity is a prior covariance for two-parameter Poisson–Dirichlet random frequencies, not a posterior covariance conditional on observed counts.
The simple rational covariance is not asserted for arbitrary Gnedin–Pitman priors.
A residual bibliographic risk remains because mixed power-sum identities are classical and an older source could contain the same derivative consequence under different notation.
title: Shannon and Gini–Simpson diversity have an exact Poisson–Dirichlet covariance
